squirrel.schemas.workspace

class squirrel.schemas.workspace.DataSource(**data)[source]

Bases: BaseModel

A single input source attached to a workspace.

Generic across source kinds (“upload” | “connector”) and, within uploads, across file types — a CSV source populates columns / row_count; other file types (once implemented) may leave those unset and rely on connector_id being absent to distinguish themselves from connector sources.

Parameters:

  • source_id (str)

  • kind (str)

  • name (str)

  • file_type (str | None)

  • file_url (str | None)

  • columns (List[str] | None)

  • all_columns (List[str] | None)

  • row_count (int | None)

  • connector_id (str | None)

  • table (str | None)

  • query (str | None)

model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = {}

Configuration for the model, should be a dictionary conforming to [ConfigDict][pydantic.config.ConfigDict].

class squirrel.schemas.workspace.PreprocessRequest(**data)[source]

Bases: BaseModel

Request payload for POST /preprocess.

Callers must supply a conversationId so the workspace row can be linked to the chat history, and a workspaceId for workspace-level queries. The fileUrls list must contain at least one s3:// URL pointing to the raw CSV that the preprocessing agent should clean.

Parameters:

  • workspaceId (str)

  • conversationId (str)

  • fileUrls (List[str])

  • edaSummary (Dict[str, Any] | None)

  • objective (str | None)

  • query (str | None)

model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = {}

Configuration for the model, should be a dictionary conforming to [ConfigDict][pydantic.config.ConfigDict].

class squirrel.schemas.workspace.ModelBuildRequest(**data)[source]

Bases: BaseModel

Request payload for POST /model-build.

fileUrls should point to the processed CSV(s) produced by the preprocessing pipeline (i.e. outputFileUrls from a PreprocessResponse). targetColumn is the name of the label column in that CSV.

  • conversationId (str)

  • fileUrls (List[str])

class squirrel.schemas.workspace.PredictRequest(**data)[source]

Bases: BaseModel

Body for POST /workspace/{workspace_id}/predict.

rows should be shaped like the workspace’s original raw input source(s) — i.e. exactly what you’d upload as a CSV row or pull from a connector — not already preprocessed. The saved fitted pipeline handles cleaning/encoding/scaling internally.

  • rows (List[Dict[str, Any]])

  • model_key (str | None)
